decisions.decision: Town Counsel relayed the Board's settlement offer to opposing counsel: agree to remand on three terms (plans with red and pink revisions, adherence to the contingent settlement agreement, and tree fund increase to $50,000).
decisions.quote: the board's offer was to agree to remand with the following terms.

decisions.decision: Tree fund spending will be done at the Board's discretion through a single point of contact the Board identifies.
decisions.quote: the board would spend the funds at its discretion through a single point of contact identified by the board.

decisions.decision: The Board needs to determine a single point of contact (e.g., Land Use Director, Board member, or landscape architect) to talk with abutters about plantings; a tree plan will be created for Board review after abutter and landscape architect conversations.
decisions.quote: the board needs to determine a single point of contact, e.g., land use director, board member, landscape architect.

decisions.decision: Town Counsel will verify with opposing counsel what constitutes construction completion; A. Burney anticipates it will be when the project is turned on.
decisions.quote: a. burney anticipates that will be when the project is turned on; a. costa will verify with m. rosen.

decisions.decision: Town Counsel advised that once the new application is submitted, it be sent out for peer review.
decisions.quote: a. costa advised that as soon as the new application is submitted, it be sent out for peer review.

budget_items.topic: Tree fund increase in settlement offer
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board's settlement offer included raising the tree fund from $10,000 to $50,000; opposing counsel agreed to an increase of $40,000 with conditions.
budget_items.quote: the plaintiff would agree to an increase in the tree fund from $10,000 to the amount of $50,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Opposing counsel requested the professional fee for a landscape architect be capped at $5,000, and the motion authorized that $5,000 limit.
budget_items.quote: m. rosen requested the professional fee be capped at $5,000.

budget_items.topic: Tree fund spending deadline and return of remaining funds
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Opposing counsel wanted a 36-month limit from construction completion on spending tree funds; funds remaining after that would be returned to the applicant under the motion.
budget_items.quote: m. rosen wanted a time limit of thirty-six (36) months from completion of construction placed on spending of the tree

budget_items.topic: Estimated cost of replanting after clear cutting
budget_items.what_was_recorded: T. Cole asserted that the $50,000 would easily be spent replanting if 34 acres were clear cut, with any remainder going to the Town.
budget_items.quote: t. cole asserted that if you clear cut 34 acres, the $50,000 will easily be spent replanting
